hints.title: Mismatch Pair Classification
hints.text: Count all character positions where source differs from target, categorizing by the character transition needed.

hints.title: Greedy Reciprocal Swapping
hints.text: Pair opposite transitions such as a to b with b to a to fix two characters in a single operation.

hints.title: Remaining Replacements
hints.text: Any leftover mismatches cannot be resolved in two-for-one pairs and require one individual operation each.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def minOperations(self, source: str, target: str) -> int:
        if len(source) != len(target):
            return -1
        
        count = defaultdict(int)
        total_mismatches = 0
        for s, t in zip(source, target):
            if s != t:
                count[(s, t)] += 1
                total_mismatches += 1
                
        saved = 0
        chars = list(set([u for u, v in count.keys()] + [v for u, v in count.keys()]))
        
        # 2-cycles
        for i in range(len(chars)):
            for j in range(i + 1, len(chars)):
                u, v = chars[i], chars[j]
                k = min(count[(u, v)], count[(v, u)])
                saved += k
                count[(u, v)] -= k
                count[(v, u)] -= k
                
        # 3-cycles
        for i in range(len(chars)):
            for j in range(len(chars)):
                if i == j: continue
                for m in range(len(chars)):
                    if m == i or m == j: continue
                    u, v, w = chars[i], chars[j], chars[m]
                    k = min(count[(u, v)], count[(v, w)], count[(w, u)])
                    if k > 0:
                        saved += k
                        count[(u, v)] -= k
                        count[(v, w)] -= k
                        count[(w, u)] -= k
                        
        return total_mismatches - saved
```

complexity.notes: Constant alphabet size matrix tracking transitions and pairing reciprocals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of swap choices leads to factorial complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using a fixed 26x26 array provides instantaneous lookups for character transitions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that 2-cycles save one operation per pair over naive replacements.
